name: io.github.taliasoftworks/planvortex
description: Schedule posts, read comments and answer messages across eleven social networks with PlanVortex.

environment_variables.name: PLANVORTEX_CLIENT_ID
environment_variables.description: Client id of a PlanVortex app (Custom plan). Panel: Settings > Apps.

environment_variables.name: PLANVORTEX_ORGANIZATION_ID
environment_variables.description: Default organization id. Optional: saves a discovery call per conversation.

environment_variables.name: PLANVORTEX_MCP_UPLOAD_DIRS
environment_variables.description: Directories upload_media may read from. Empty means none.

environment_variables.name: PLANVORTEX_MCP_READ_ONLY
environment_variables.description: Set to 1 to remove the nine write tools.
